The locations listed below are the designated polling places for the November 3, 2026 General Election.  Any voter who is registered to vote at an address within the boundaries of St. Louis City can vote at any of the listed locations on November 3, 2026.

No Excuse Absentee Polling Places

No Excuse Absentee Voting is an in-person absentee option for all voters during the two weeks before each election. No absentee voting excuse is necessary, and you do not need to apply for a ballot. You can cast your vote at any of the locations below. Call libraries to confirm hours of operations.

Polling Place Zip Polling Address
Buder Library 63109 4401 HAMPTON AVE
Carpenter Branch Library 63118 3309 S GRAND BLVD
Julia Davis Library 63115 4415 NATURAL BRIDGE AVE
Kingshighway Branch Library 63110 2260 S VANDEVENTER AVE
Schlafly Library 63108 225 N EUCLID AVE
St. Joan of Arc 63139 5821 PERNOD AVE
Entrance: Gym
St. Louis City Election Board 63101 300 N TUCKER BLVD
Walnut Park Library 63120 5760 W FLORISSANT AVE

Hours

Hours for Carpenter Library, Kingshighway Branch Library, and Walnut Park Library No Excuse Absentee Voting Locations:

  • Monday: 1 PM-4PM
  • Tuesday-Thursday: 11AM-5PM
  • Friday and Saturday: 11 AM-4:30 PM
  • Sunday: Closed

Hours for Buder Library, Schlafly Library, and Julia Davis Library No Excuse Absentee Voting Locations:

  • Monday: 1 PM-4PM
  • Tuesday: 11AM-5PM
  • Wednesday and Thursday: 11AM-7PM
  • Friday and Saturday: 11 AM-4:30 PM
  • Sunday: Closed

St. Joan of Arc No Excuse Absentee Voting Hours (Oct. 27-Nov. 2 ONLY):

  • Monday, Nov 2: 1 PM-4PM
  • Tuesday, Oct. 27: 11AM-5PM
  • Wednesday, Oct 28 and Thursday, Oct. 29: 11AM-7PM
  • Friday, Oct. 30 and Saturday, Oct. 31 11 AM-4:30 PM
  • Sunday: Closed

Hours for the St. Louis City Election Board:

  • Monday-Friday: 8 AM–5 PM
  • Last Saturday Before Election Day: 9 AM-1 PM
